mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate indicates monetary easing, which may lead to increased borrowing and investment, thereby driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are not positively correlated with declines in FEDFUNDS, or if the Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate suggests a strong labor market, which may boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE decreases by 0.2pp in one month
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 40% of cases when UNRATE decreases by 0.2pp.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts indicates strong demand in the housing market, which may lead to increased economic activity and positive S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 returns are not positively correlated with HOUST increases, or if the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low unemployment and high payroll employment suggests a strong economy, but may indicate late-cycle expansion, leading to negative S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 50% of cases when UNRATE is below 4% and PAYEMS increases.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production suggests strong economic activity, which may lead to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 returns are not positively correlated with INDPRO increases, or if the Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A slowdown in real federal spending suggests reduced demand, which may lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 50% of cases when RSAFS growth slows.

mechanism_narrative: Positive trend in GDP indicates economic growth, which may lead to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 returns are not positively correlated with GDPC1 growth, or if the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Rising inflation and increasing federal funds rate may lead to tighter monetary conditions, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL increases by 0.5% and FEDFUNDS increases by 0.25%
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 40% of cases when CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS increase.
